source_reviews.thematic_inclusion: HackTricks Cloud Best Practices security configuration; root owns canonical tags and UI existing service groups.
source_reviews.criterion: At least one enabled Audit category, or audit/allLogs category group, in a diagnostic setting; unreadable settings MANUAL upstream.
source_reviews.differences: Native check additionally verifies supported Audit category/group and a syntactically valid destination. Missing categories or denied/partial child reads UNKNOWN; enabled metrics or unrelated logs never pass. The generic azure.gap.audit_diagnostic_setting requires owner-selected resource types/categories/sinks and is not this specific no-owner-policy Audit declaration.

metadata.title: AI services model deployment blocks jailbreak attempts with Prompt Shields

source_reviews.thematic_inclusion: HackTricks Cloud Best Practices security configuration; root owns canonical tags and UI existing service groups.
source_reviews.criterion: Each text-capable deployment must explicitly name a readable RAI policy with enabled=true and blocking=true Jailbreak/Prompt filter. Default/unknown policy MANUAL; known non-text models skipped upstream.
source_reviews.differences: One finding per account aggregates explicitly supported text deployments. Empty/all-known-nontext inventory NOT_APPLICABLE; missing/open unknown capabilities UNKNOWN rather than speculative text/nontext applicability. A known violating deployment FAILs the account; unresolved/default deployment prevents an all-pass result. Missing/foreign/duplicate/partial policy inventory never supplies a guessed named/default policy.
source_reviews.output: Reports explicit blocking Jailbreak/Prompt configuration for supported text deployments. Runtime prompt resistance and unknown default policies are not inferred.

function_sources_once.source:
def _answer(failed, observed, **evidence):
    return ('FAIL' if failed else 'PASS'), dict(observed=observed, **evidence)

native_request_contract.scope: Explicit same UUID subscription and canonical Account path; detail ID/type/name agree; every child ID/name/type binds to exact account and child kind, case-insensitively. Duplicates rejected. Destination resource IDs may legitimately be cross-subscription references; not inventory joins.
native_request_contract.pagination: Actual value/nextLink lists, same origin/path enforced by reader, exact API version and no filter/top narrowing in focused adapter; duplicate/foreign/partial child data withheld. Account LIST plus one bound GET/account shared across the four controls; diagnostic/category/deployment/policy reads are selected only for relevant controls.
native_request_contract.omissions: Successful full GET identity omission/null means no identity declaration; missing outbound flag, deployment capability, filter booleans and default/named-unresolved policies do not become compliance.
native_request_contract.secrets: Account apiProperties and all noncontract raw child body fields discarded; evidence uses brief field-backed English observations, flags and result counts.

proof_limits: No live Azure/auth/resource/role calls; no traffic generation, prompt evaluation, event ingestion, sink authorization, DNS or effective access proof. Supported ARM metadata is a configuration contract.

NativeApi tests inject documented JSON only at transport;36 cases additionally exercise real AzureTransport GET Request objects and json decoding through fake opener. All cases hard-block socket/DNS/auth discovery. No CASES input or copied evaluator output is native proof.

Partial account inventory can retain PASS on a fully read known account plus a separate explicit UNKNOWN coverage finding; it never establishes complete subscription compliance. Empty account inventory produces engine EMPTY, not a compliance PASS.

Prompt Shield aggregates per-account results; explicit default policies and unknown capabilities remain UNKNOWN, known non-text-only deployments are excluded. Denied/partial policy/deployment inventory prevents PASS. No policy names guessed.

Existing Turbot capability exclusions and no-connection INFO/MANUAL are deliberate source semantics. New Prowler criteria are not falsely declared equivalent; root may decide future successor semantics separately.

Framework references for all nine new Prowler IDs are empty at the pinned revision. No numbered references are inferred from related Turbot controls; proposed thematic inclusion uses existing UI group structure.
New module admission/description/native-derived fixture files are local review artifacts; root owns canonical metadata, service mapping, presentation/evidence copy and source successor integration.
root_actions: Integrate four declared native IDs, descriptions, fixture provenance, existing cognitive service UI grouping/service mapping and HackTricks thematic inclusion without inventing numbered Prowler mappings.
Record five existing source dispositions, preserving their distinct capability/manual scope; do not assert one-to-one newer Prowler parity.
Review account-level Prompt Shield aggregation and unsupported/default-policy UNKNOWN as the explicit product contract.
